newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwangju Bank closes US$50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Kwangju Bank closes US$50 mln FRN.

text.p: Kwangju Bank's US$50 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger Standard Chartered Investment Banking said.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no puts or calls options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 52 basis points.
Arranger KDB Asia committed US$11 million. Arrangers with US$5 million each are Citicorp International, LTCB Asia and Standard Chartered Bank.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are American Express Bank, ING Barings Securities (HK) Ltd and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Senior manager Chase Manhattan Asia committed US$3 million. Senior managers with US$2 million each are KEXIM Asia, UBS Hong Kong and Taiwan Cooperative Bank, Offshore Banking Branch.
